\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 198-201 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R206-first-pass-words-from-chapters-198-201}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for moonlight and a tempest.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a wire, a screen, a camera, a passport, a visa
  \item a chapati, ghee, spice, turmeric, cumin
  \item a pakora, korma, pickle, raita, a salad
  \item hockey, tennis, chess, playing cards, a race
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A wire? (\textbf{\ur{تار}}, \emph{tār}.) A screen? (\textbf{\ur{سکرین}}, \emph{skrīn}.) A camera? (\textbf{\ur{کیمرہ}}, \emph{kaimrā}.) A passport? (\textbf{\ur{پاسپورٹ}}, \emph{pāsporṭ}.) A visa? (\textbf{\ur{ویزا}}, \emph{vīzā}.) A chapati? (\textbf{\ur{چپاتی}}, \emph{chapātī}.) Ghee? (\textbf{\ur{گھی}}, \emph{ghī}.) Spice? (\textbf{\ur{مسالہ}}, \emph{masālā}.) Turmeric? (\textbf{\ur{ہلدی}}, \emph{haldī}.) Cumin? (\textbf{\ur{زیرہ}}, \emph{zīrā}.) A pakora? (\textbf{\ur{پکوڑا}}, \emph{pakoṛā}.) Korma? (\textbf{\ur{قورمہ}}, \emph{qormā}.) Pickle? (\textbf{\ur{اچار}}, \emph{achār}.) Raita? (\textbf{\ur{رائتہ}}, \emph{rāytā}.) A salad? (\textbf{\ur{سلاد}}, \emph{salād}.) Hockey? (\textbf{\ur{ہاکی}}, \emph{hākī}.) Tennis? (\textbf{\ur{ٹینس}}, \emph{ṭenis}.) Chess? (\textbf{\ur{شطرنج}}, \emph{shatranj}.) Playing cards? (\textbf{\ur{تاش}}, \emph{tāsh}.) A race? (\textbf{\ur{دوڑ}}, \emph{dauṛ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 202-206 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R206-second-pass-words-from-chapters-202-206}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a party and a gift.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a party, a gift, a traveller, a taxi, a rickshaw
  \item a maternal uncle, a maternal aunt, a paternal aunt, a nephew, a grandson
  \item a number, news, a matter, a conversation, advice
  \item a law, a right, a duty, progress, success
  \item dust, smoke, ash, moonlight, a tempest
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A party? (\textbf{\ur{پارٹی}}, \emph{pārṭī}.) A gift? (\textbf{\ur{تحفہ}}, \emph{tohfā}.) A traveller? (\textbf{\ur{مسافر}}, \emph{musāfir}.) A taxi? (\textbf{\ur{ٹیکسی}}, \emph{ṭaiksī}.) A rickshaw? (\textbf{\ur{رکشہ}}, \emph{rikshā}.) A maternal uncle? (\textbf{\ur{ماموں}}, \emph{māmūṅ}.) A maternal aunt? (\textbf{\ur{خالہ}}, \emph{khālā}.) A paternal aunt? (\textbf{\ur{پھوپھی}}, \emph{phuphī}.) A nephew? (\textbf{\ur{بھتیجا}}, \emph{bhatījā}.) A grandson? (\textbf{\ur{پوتا}}, \emph{potā}.) A number? (\textbf{\ur{نمبر}}, \emph{nambar}.) News? (\textbf{\ur{خبر}}, \emph{khabar}.) A matter? (\textbf{\ur{بات}}, \emph{bāt}.) A conversation? (\textbf{\ur{بات} \ur{چیت}}, \emph{bātchīt}.) Advice? (\textbf{\ur{مشورہ}}, \emph{mashvarā}.) A law? (\textbf{\ur{قانون}}, \emph{qānūn}.) A right? (\textbf{\ur{حق}}, \emph{haq}.) A duty? (\textbf{\ur{فرض}}, \emph{farz}.) Progress? (\textbf{\ur{ترقی}}, \emph{taraqqī}.) Success? (\textbf{\ur{کامیابی}}, \emph{kāmyābī}.) Dust? (\textbf{\ur{دھول}}, \emph{dhūl}.) Smoke? (\textbf{\ur{دھواں}}, \emph{dhuāṅ}.) Ash? (\textbf{\ur{راکھ}}, \emph{rākh}.) Moonlight? (\textbf{\ur{چاندنی}}, \emph{chāṅdnī}.) A tempest? (\textbf{\ur{طوفان}}, \emph{tūfān}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
